metric_definitions.verified_websites: Companies with an available official_website claim accepted by current identity policy; identity levels listed separately.
metric_definitions.social_profile_companies: Companies with at least one available social_profile.* claim.
metric_definitions.activity_companies: Companies with at least one available claim in family activity, regardless of aggregate section state.
metric_definitions.activity_claims: Available claims in family activity, including website and registry-change activity; excludes registry dates remaining in family identity.
metric_definitions.total_facts: All available source claims across all families, including compound claims as one fact; excludes placeholders, synthesis and derived summary counts.
metric_definitions.locations: Available subunits.unit.* records, excluding subunits.detail.* fields.
metric_definitions.job_ad_companies: Companies with at least one available hiring.job.* claim.
metric_definitions.contacts: Available contact.* claims (phone/email), counted per company claim.
metric_definitions.http_requests: All report requests, including retries, robots, NAV and shared registry activity; DNS is excluded.
metric_definitions.runtime_seconds: Runner report runtime_ms / 1000; captured before optional profile/site/report completion.
metric_definitions.process_wall_seconds: Stopwatch around the exact uv command, including launcher and all final output/site work.
